#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: So, how do you like it?
Bot: …
You: I mean the decorations. Do you like them? Landlord gave them to me.
Bot: Oh, right. They look… {{wi}}To be honest, I have no idea how they look. What’s their purpose?
You: These are Halloween decorations. People all over the world, in some places more than others, are putting these spooky things all over their homes.
Bot: Halloween?
I sometimes forget that she’s a sexbot and doesn’t know the most obvious things…
You: I should explain that from the start then.
You: Halloween is one of my favorite holidays. There are many great ways to celebrate it: wearing a costume, telling scary stories, carving pumpkins, trick-or-treating and of course decorating your home.
Bot: That’s a lot of things to do seemingly for no reason.
You: Well, there’s a reason. They are fun things to do.
You: How about this Halloween we will try to do some of these things, huh? Maybe you will like it after all.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Sure, why not.
